correctness.rationale: For all n>=1, every joint required-peak event is either impossible due to adjacency or factors into disjoint alternating blocks with tangent coefficients E_(2r+1)/(2r+1)!. The odd-denominator induction from tan derivative proves these probabilities lie in Z_(2); Walsh expansion is 1 mod 2 in this ring after division by n!, proving exact valuations and no zeros. Walsh inversion modulo every odd prime and the 2^(n-1) peak-free count prove the exact gcd. Direct enumeration through n=8, independent exact descent and moment spectra through n=13, and 12,442 assertions corroborate without replacing the proof.
